entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A deity who needs no book to record every act.

entities.name: Pendelhaven
entities.description: A place whose limbs extend as far as the meek roam and as high as they strive.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angelic figure whose war blessing commands the resurrected to fight for her cause.

entities.name: Mwonvuli
entities.description: A land where root systems twist through currents of mana rather than soil.

entities.name: Raissa
entities.description: A person who transformed herself into a vessel for the Watchword Codex.

entities.name: Watchword Codex

entities.name: Krark Clan
entities.description: A goblin clan to whom every artifact has a trigger and a barrel.
